why: Check: requesting the same background color twice applies it both times and the second result is not cache data; key changes state the repeat returns the cache.
No check that scrollbars are painted while an element is selected; the scrollbar-drag check has no selection trigger and nothing says the early return could skip scrollbars.
Only checks the handle and outline alignment on a rotated shape; no zoom-varied check of the rotation handle position.
Group checks cover outline, selection and shortcuts but none verifies a grouped element's stacking order relative to other elements.
Only tests undo after entering editing mode; no check of undo after dragging or finishing a point edit.
Only a multi-element selection drag is checked; no drag of a grouped element is exercised.
Check: when the collaboration click handler is omitted the collaboration button is absent; when supplied it appears and invokes the handler.

Generous: check 'loading a non-collaboration scene with elements outside its saved viewport ... brought into view using current canvas dimensions and position' in a non-zero offset context; does not state init explicitly.
Only edit-then-remove-all-text check (arrow expected to unbind); no edit of bound text that keeps the arrow attached.
Group checks only group after text exists or drag ungrouped shape; no check adds text to a container already inside a group and verifies the text joins the group.
No check places the canvas away from page origin or checks popup position against the element at an offset.
Generic check that the control appears for a selection of only elements with attached text or attached to a container; no empty selection and no explicit mixed selection.
No check opens a scene via the file picker and then saves back; only load/display checks.
With the diagonal line selected, click inside its bounding box away from the line and expect no hit; does not explicitly say it should deselect.
Only midpoint/collab alignment checks; nothing with another element overlapping the line's point handles.
Generic check that child content displays; no minified build and no mechanism stated.
Only selection-lookup refactor checks; no Alt-drag duplication or undo/restore of deleted elements.
Tests H for hand tool only; no Alt+Shift+H check.
Sidebar tab checks go through UI triggers, not calling toggleSidebar with another tab while open.
Snapshot/history checks only; no older-browser condition.
Search for lowercase 'change-background' (and 'dark') must find capitalized command labels; implicit lowercase-vs-capitalized trigger, case never named.
Only checks undo/redo disabled on empty history and after edits; never toggles view mode and checks the buttons' state.
No Alt+click check at all; elbow checks cover editor not offered and midpoint drag not inserting a point.
Check expects the completed laser stroke to disappear, which matches the buggy instant vanish; fade-out is never mentioned.
Only checks a lowercase iphone platform; no undefined platform/userAgent environment or load-crash check.
Message deletion check only verifies which messages are removed; no check that the preview re-renders after removal.
Cluster growth check only asserts earlier nodes stay in place; no check that pending children are centered on the parent.
No step deletes a frame child above the frame and then adds a new child; insertion checks lack the deletion trigger.
